tasks.title: Inventory and hash the v1 corpus
tasks.instructions: Build a complete v1 file inventory with relative paths, sizes, SHA-256 hashes, formats, and duplicate candidates. Exclude Moodify Ear v2 from the v1 corpus.

tasks.title: Resolve duplicate chapter sources
tasks.instructions: Compare duplicate Chapter 02-04 directories and packages byte-for-byte and semantically. Recommend the authoritative copy without deleting anything. Mark unresolved differences for human review.

tasks.title: Define v1 and v2 isolation rules
tasks.instructions: Document deterministic inclusion and exclusion rules so v2 material can never enter the v1 batch accidentally.

tasks.title: Verify package consistency
tasks.instructions: Verify manifest, Markdown, PDF, README, references, and ZIP membership consistency for every authoritative v1 chapter package.

tasks.title: Scan text integrity and references
tasks.instructions: Detect encoding damage, mojibake, broken references, missing files, malformed headings, and chapter metadata conflicts. Do not silently rewrite scholarly content.

tasks.title: Create normalized read-only corpus index
tasks.instructions: Create a normalized manifest pointing to authoritative immutable source files. Preserve hashes and provenance; do not copy heavy PDFs unless required.

tasks.title: Extract chapter claims
tasks.instructions: Extract atomic claims from all 20 chapters with chapter, section, source path, claim type, and confidence. Preserve the distinction between proposal and verified fact.

tasks.title: Extract WSE MSE PPE concepts
tasks.instructions: Build a sourced concept map for WSE, MSE, and PPE, including definitions, inputs, outputs, boundaries, and cross-discipline dependencies.

tasks.title: Extract component and interface candidates
tasks.instructions: Extract candidate components, contracts, schemas, and interfaces. Label them as textual proposals rather than implemented architecture.

tasks.title: Extract measurement and evidence requirements
tasks.instructions: Extract what is measured, what evidence is produced, how results are verified, and what happens on failure.

tasks.title: Classify theory experiment and verified capability
tasks.instructions: Classify every material claim as theory, hypothesis, experimental evidence, current verified capability, historical statement, or unresolved. Never promote a claim from documentation alone.

tasks.title: Build chapter requirement evidence traceability
tasks.instructions: Link chapter claims to requirements, proposed components, measurements, evidence, validation, and failure semantics.

tasks.title: Inventory current repository capabilities
tasks.instructions: Inspect verified mainline code and tests. Record CANONICAL, EXPERIMENTAL, LEGACY, HISTORICAL, ABSENT, or UNRESOLVED with concrete paths and test evidence.

tasks.title: Compare material requirements to implementation
tasks.instructions: Compare sourced Ear v1 requirements with verified repository capabilities. Do not treat planned architecture as implemented.

tasks.title: Classify canonical experimental and legacy areas
tasks.instructions: Apply repository authority rules and identify classifications that require a human decision.

tasks.title: Identify orchestration authority conflicts
tasks.instructions: Locate duplicate or competing orchestration systems and explain risks without modifying or deleting them.

tasks.title: Define Ear 1.0 engineering scope
tasks.instructions: Draft an evidence-backed implementation scope, non-goals, human-authority points, and unresolved architecture decisions.

tasks.title: Generate engineering epics
tasks.instructions: Generate outcome-oriented epics tied to traceability identifiers and repository authority.

tasks.title: Decompose epics into verifiable work items
tasks.instructions: Create small work items with inputs, allowed paths, outputs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, recovery behavior, and evidence requirements.

tasks.title: Design tests and evidence for work items
tasks.instructions: For every work item specify automated tests, evidence artifacts, failure handling, and any required human listening judgment.

tasks.title: Build prioritized execution DAG
tasks.instructions: Build a cycle-free dependency graph and prioritize foundational, low-risk, high-evidence tasks.

tasks.title: Select unattended-safe implementation batch
tasks.instructions: Select only reversible, bounded, testable work that requires no listening judgment, external authorization, secrets, publishing, deletion, or authority change.
